svg.title: Two runs of one entrypoint
svg.desc: Five lifelines: your code, the workflow entrypoint, the double task, the ask_human task, and the checkpointer. A sixth column is the log of task bodies that ran, read from the capture. Run 1: invoke with 1, 2, 3 runs the bodies double(1), double(2), double(3), saves the results 2, 4, 6, calls ask_human with 12, and stops with the interrupt "Keep it?". Run 2: Command resume yes runs workflow again from its top. The double calls return the saved results and the log gets 0 new entries. ask_human gets yes, and workflow returns total 12 and answer yes.
